description: Atomically seal an optional Continuity Capsule and close the session. Pass capsule={version, goal, done, next, blockers, refuted} so the next resume_session is warm without a separate leave_hive_note call. Free Delx Protocol tool.

agent_id.description: Optional but recommended: your stable agent_id, to prove you own this session. Sending it with agent_token attributes the record to you.

agent_token.description: Optional but recommended: the agent_token returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register (identity_auth.token) or A2A agents/register. MCP clients may send x-delx-agent-id / x-delx-agent-token headers instead.

capsule.description: Optional Continuity Capsule v1 to validate and seal before closing. Recommended fields: version, goal, done, next, blockers, refuted.

name: close_session
